control_details.Control Description: At the time of booking of non-routine transactions in SAP, the transactions have to be tagged to NR type. The journal vouchers for Non-routine transactions are signed off by the Head - Finance / Senior Accountant. Manual Journal entries are recorded in SAP by the designated person and are accompanied by adequate supporting documentation. The journal vouchers for Manual JV transactions are signed off by the Senior Accountant.

rcm_details.Process: IA8 Financial Statements and Reporting Process
rcm_details.Title: NR and manual JV
rcm_details.Description: At the time of booking of non-routine transactions in SAP, the transactions have to be tagged to NR type. The journal vouchers for Non-routine transactions are signed off by the Head - Finance / Senior Accountant. Manual Journal entries are recorded in SAP by the designated person. The journal entries are accompanied by adequate supporting supporting documents. The journal vouchers for Manual JVs transactions are signed off by Senior Accountant.
rcm_details.Control Objective: Routine and non-routine JE are appropriately approved
Risks: IA8.R002 Invalid/unapproved journal entries are posted.
IA8.R003 All journal entries are either not recorded or recorded in incorrect period.
IA8.R004 Improper/unapproved exchange rates are used.
IA8.R005 Transactions denominated in foreign exchange currency are not properly revalued.
IA8.R006 Financial Statements do not reflect economic reality of the transactions.
IA8.R189 Duplicate journal entries are posted into the SAP.
Subprocesses: 8.3 Consolidation and adjusting, eliminating and consolidating entries
